entries.zh: 被判死刑者（死罪定谳之人）；因
entries.en: one condemned to death; condemned criminal (attainder of capital punishment)
entries.notes: 西语 'Condenado a muerte' 与汉字'因'配合较弱，'因'或为'囚'之形讹/简写，判词以西语与音写 fū（囚）为准，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 判处三年军徒刑者（解发充军三年）
entries.en: condemned to serve three years as a soldier in exile (military penal exile)

entries.zh: 流放服劳役者（流徒之刑）
entries.en: condemned to penal labor in banishment (deportation with forced labor)

entries.zh: 发配充徒刑者（判处徒刑）
entries.en: sentenced to hard labor (penal servitude pronounced)

entries.zh: 问成死罪（判死罪）
entries.en: to sentence to death (interrogate and condemn a capital crime)
entries.notes: '死'音栏标 T99 污损，但汉字与西语清晰互证，判词本身可靠，仅音注受损故降 medium。

entries.zh: 问打皮鞭之罪（判鞭刑）
entries.en: to sentence to flogging (whipping with the leather whip)
entries.notes: '打''鞭'两音栏均标 T99 污损，唯汉字'問打皮鞭'与西语 azotes 互证清楚，降 medium。

entries.zh: 问罪定赎（依判例定罪科刑）
entries.en: to condemn by (remitting) judgment; assess the crime and fix the penalty/redemption
entries.notes: '赎'音有 T99 且字形展开依赖推断（sïōg），罪名与刑罚折赎之义据汉字与西语 sentencia 推定，降 medium。

entries.zh: 发站充役（判摆站，如划桨苦役）
entries.en: condemned to post-station service; sentenced to the galleys (public labor at stations)

entries.zh: 问发轧船（判充划桨船苦役）
entries.en: to sentence to the galleys (condemn a man to row in a war galley)

entries.zh: 终身充军者（终世军，永戍之兵）
entries.en: condemned to perpetual military exile (life-term soldier in banishment)
entries.notes: '世'音栏 T99 污损；汉字'終世軍'与西语 soldado perpetuo 互证清楚，仅音注受损故 medium。

entries.zh: 死囚（候决之犯人）
entries.en: condemned criminal; prisoner awaiting execution (death-row convict)
entries.notes: 官话对音 zǔ chêñ（囚 qín）与闽音 sy fū 存在系统差异，汉字'死囚'清晰，释义据汉字与西语，对音差异存疑故 medium。

entries.zh: 获罪之人（犯罪者，有罪之身）
entries.en: convicted culprit; one guilty of a crime
entries.notes: 汉字栏原作'犯罪 [疑:犯罪/紀罪]'，字形有疑，但西语 condenado culpado 与音写互证清楚，降 medium。

entries.zh: 气（天生禀气，自然之质）
entries.en: natural constitution; vital breath/temperament (qi, innate disposition)
entries.notes: 官话对音 gùi 的声调 T99 污损；汉字'氣'与西语 Condición natural 互证清楚，仅音注受损故 medium。

entries.zh: 性（本性，天然之性）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: natural disposition; innate nature (temperament) 〔original partially damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 闽南音栏标 [残]，第二音节 fē 难辨（或为'稟/命'），据汉字'性'与西语 Condición natural 暂定。

entries.zh: 情（人情、情状）
entries.en: condition; circumstances, feelings (the state of things, human sentiment)

entries.zh: 强（性情刚强；桀骜之性）
entries.en: fierce temperament; strong-willed (a bad, harsh disposition)
entries.notes: 西语 terible（terrible）为'恶劣难驯'义，汉字'強'与官话 quàng（強 quàng 去声）相合，语义方向据 17 世纪词义推定故 medium。

entries.zh: 狂（性情狂悖，肆无忌惮）
entries.en: wild, unrestrained disposition; mad or outrageous temperament

entries.zh: 润（性温润；和顺之质）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: mild, smooth (pleasant) disposition; temperament like polished jade 〔original unclear; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏'閏 [疑:閏/潤]'且两音注均 T99；据西语 condicion buena（好性情）取'潤（温润）'义，字形不可确认故 low。

entries.zh: 心性（心之本性，天资）
entries.en: natural disposition of the heart; innate character, temperament

entries.zh: 性气（禀性气质）
entries.en: natural temperament; disposition and humour (one's character)

entries.zh: 拗怒（性情恶劣，易怒好斗）
entries.en: bad temper, peevish and wrathful disposition; easily angered
entries.notes: 汉字栏'拗怒 [疑:拗怒/拘怒]'且闽南音两注均 T99；据西语 condicion mala, se enoza（恶性、易怒）暂定。
